name: Farbror Pekkas handelsbod
overview: Farbror Pekkas handelsbod was the 1965 Advent calendar produced by Sveriges Radio and Sveriges Television. In the fictional village of Vinterbo, Pekka Langer runs a small general store at the foot of a mountain, selling Christmas goods to the local villagers. As Christmas approaches, the shop is visited by a variety of customers, including a family from the city and a Sami family, each bringing new encounters and stories to the store.
